title: Bioluminescence Resonance Energy Transfer at Various Ratios of Expressed Proteins
author: Benoit Besson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jepcjdn

steps.title: Plate and pre‑incubate cells
steps.instruction: Seed HEK‑293T cells, centrifuge, and incubate before transfection.

substeps.instruction: Plate 3000 cells per well in a 384‑well plate with 50 µL of medium.
Centrifuge the plate at 900 g for 1 min.

steps.title: Prepare DNA transfection mix
steps.instruction: Make the plasmid‑DNA‑DuGENE6 mixture and add it to the cells.

substeps.instruction: Combine 25 ng of each plasmid (Nluc‑tagged and YFP‑tagged) in 1 µL DMEM without FBS; use a 1:1 ratio unless a different Nluc:YFP ratio (2:1 to 1:4) is required.
Add 0.15 µL DuGENE6 (Promega) to 4 µL DMEM without FBS and mix.
Incubate the mixture 30 min at room temperature.
Gently add 5 µL of the DNA‑DuGENE6 mix to each well.

steps.title: Measure donor and acceptor luminescence
steps.instruction: Read bioluminescence from Nluc (donor) and YFP (acceptor) using a plate reader (e.g., Wallac 1420 VICTOR 3V, PerkinElmer).

steps.title: Calculate BRET values
steps.instruction: Compute BRET efficiency and define interaction thresholds.

substeps.instruction: Calculate CF = (NlucY value / Nluc value) using the linked recombinant protein.
Set a specific‑interaction threshold as mean + 3 SD of the negative controls for each experiment.
